name: Tele-Direct Atlantic Doom: Re-Dialed
summary: Tele-Direct Atlantic Doom: Re-Dialed is a 42-level megawad for MBF21-compatible source ports, with levels, art, and music from various contributors. It is an unofficial "sequel" to Tele-Direct Atlantic Doom, a 1997 level by Lawrence Harrison recreating his office building at Tele-Direct Atlantic, a branch of what is now Yellow Pages Limited in Canada. Lawrence's original map replaced imps with the company's cartoon mascot, Telly. Re-Dialed dials it up, featuring several new, increasingly off-brand-guideline "Tellies" as custom monsters.
